records.source_statement: In certain Venus/Mercury configurations Lilly explicitly distinguishes friendship or speech from alleged acts.
limitations: Do not conflate social friendliness with infidelity.

records.source_statement: Seventh ruler or Moon with Saturn is associated with a supposed older, religious or sober person.
limitations: Historical stereotypes, not identified third party.

records.source_statement: Seventh ruler with Sun is interpreted as affection for a prominent person, with reception changing whether feeling continues.
limitations: Reception and absence of reception are different branches.

records.source_statement: Several planets regarding Sun with seventh ruler are used to suggest multiple acquaintances, with author considering delay or tardiness.
Separate section asks whether one's wife or lover has another 'sweetheart'.
limitations: Source contains gendered assumptions; no scientific validity.

records.source_statement: Planet in seventh is assigned an alleged counterpart's acquaintance by planet class, subject to whether it rules seventh.
limitations: Occupant must be distinguished from seventh-house ruler.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord void of course or matching source node is offered as one indication of no other attachment.
limitations: Positive absence inference is not verified.

records.source_statement: Moon/seventh ruler with Mars can be interpreted as a friend the woman respects but does not approach dishonestly.
limitations: An important source exception to automatic affair allegations.

records.source_statement: When woman poses analogous question about a man, the author advises analogous assessment with relative signifiers reversed.
limitations: Do not fix historical gendered labels across changing querent.
